newsitem.title: BELGIUM: All AEA Sept figures up except for N America.
newsitem.headline: All AEA Sept figures up except for N America.

text.p: The Association of European Airlines (AEA) figures for September show volume increases on all markets except the North Atlantic trade.

A statement from the association shows that two market sectors; Europe-North Africa/Middle East and the South Atlantic trade have seen the largest increases in revenue freight tonne kilometres, being 15 percent up (to 91.2 million RTFK) and 21.8 percent up (to 114.7 million RTFK) respectively for the month of September.
However the North Atlantic trade saw a 0.3 percent decline when it fell slightly to 688 million RTFK for September 1996, compared to the same month last year.
figures relate to the international scheduled services of AEA member airlines. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
